mapper.select: SELECT i.inquiry_no,c.application_no,COALESCE(c.policy_no,a.policy_no) policy_no, i.underwriting_case_no,i.application_revision, c.underwriting_status,c.underwriting_decision_code,c.decision_reason_code, i.inquiry_status,i.issued_at,i.resolved_at,a.application_status,a.product_code,a.application_date, a.requested_effective_date,a.currency_code,a.sum_assured_amount,a.premium_amount, ap.customer_id applicant_customer_id,ac.customer_name applicant_name, ip.customer_id insured_customer_id,ic.customer_name insured_name FROM new_contract.underwriting_inquiry i JOIN new_contract.underwriting_case c ON c.underwriting_case_no=i.underwriting_case_no JOIN new_contract.insurance_application a ON a.application_no=c.application_no JOIN new_contract.application_party ap ON ap.application_no=a.application_no AND ap.party_role_code='APPLICANT' JOIN customer.customer_master ac ON ac.customer_id=ap.customer_id JOIN new_contract.application_party ip ON ip.application_no=a.application_no AND ip.party_role_code='INSURED' JOIN customer.customer_master ic ON ic.customer_id=ip.customer_id WHERE i.inquiry_no=#{query} OR c.application_no=#{query} OR a.policy_no=#{query} ORDER BY i.issued_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT x.rule_code,COALESCE(r.rule_name_zh_tw,x.rule_code) rule_name,x.item_message,x.response_text,x.responded_at FROM new_contract.underwriting_inquiry_item x LEFT JOIN new_contract.underwriting_rule_definition r ON r.rule_code=x.rule_code AND r.enabled=TRUE WHERE x.inquiry_no=#{inquiryNo} ORDER BY x.inquiry_item_id
